Hi Lydia — thanks for the PO and for laying out the preference. We can do exactly what you describe: a portal opt-in pilot for the next two invoices, with email copies to ap@greenridge.io while you validate imports. Notes below and a quick checklist so procurement has what it needs.

Summary / proposal
- Pilot: invoices dated Feb and Mar 2029 pushed to GreenRidge AP portal (API push); concurrent PDF copies emailed to ap@greenridge.io for two cycles.
- Sender: invoices will be issued by Redwood Inference, LLC (please confirm if GreenRidge needs the legal entity name altered on the invoice).
- VAT: we'll include Redwood's VAT/Tax ID and attach VAT evidence when requested. Please confirm the VAT fields you require (VAT ID on invoice, separate VAT certificate file, or both).
- Agreement: no DocuSign addendum required for the pilot; if you want portal access with automated SFTP credentials we'll generate an onboarding SOW.

Requested from GreenRidge (action items)
1) Confirm invoice sender name exactly as it must appear for your AP system (legal entity + remit address).
2) Confirm email copy address for validation (you already listed ap@greenridge.io — is there a CC distribution list?).
3) Confirm preferred invoice number prefix for your reconciliation (optional).

I've attached our invoice template so your team can validate field mapping. Connor and Kimberly are copied to support setup and tax questions. Mateo from billing ops will validate the prefix mapping once we hear back.

Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Template_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Thanks — I can have the pilot configuration ready within 3 business days of your confirmation.

Best,
